mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity_member (activity_id, user_id, created_at) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_member WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_member WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_member WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}

SELECT m.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, m.created_at AS joinedAt, m.checked_in AS checkedIn, m.checked_in_at AS checkedInAt FROM activity_member m INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC
SELECT user_id FROM activity_member WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
